categories.summary: cwe released Agent World Kit, a model-agnostic sidecar for creating persistent interactive story worlds. The project includes an elizaOS plugin with three main actions: CREATE_STORY_WORLD, ENTER_STORY_WORLD, and related functionality. The developer is seeking feedback on the plugin API design and guidance on the registry submission process. The repository is located at gh cetsell/agent-world-kit. No technical discussions, problem-solving, or implementation details were shared in this brief segment. The other messages were non-technical (team celebration and spam).
